name: Quarantine Release
author: dealerweb
description: Delivers mail from a quarantine account to its original recipients again, with the subject as the sender wrote it and without the spam headers.

quarantineAccount.label: Quarantine accounts
quarantineAccount.description: Comma-separated addresses of the accounts that hold quarantined mail. The release banner shows only there, and mail goes out with the identity of the account that is open.

allowedDomains.label: Allowed recipient domains
allowedDomains.description: Comma-separated. Only recipients in these domains can be picked, typed ones included (exact match, subdomains do not count).

recipientHeaders.label: Recipient headers
recipientHeaders.description: Comma-separated, checked in this order: the first header with addresses wins. To, Cc and Delivered-To are never used.

tagHeader.label: Subject tag header
tagHeader.description: When its value stands as "[value] " in front of the subject, delivery removes it, so the subject is the original again and a DKIM signature over it still verifies.

removeHeaders.label: Headers to remove
removeHeaders.description: Comma-separated; a trailing * matches every header starting with it. These headers are removed before delivery.
removeHeaders.default: X-Assp-*, X-Spam-*, X-Original-Authentication-Results, Authentication-Results, Delivered-To, Return-Path

releasedKeyword.label: Keyword after release
releasedKeyword.description: Set on released mail; releasing it again asks first. A tag keyword such as $label:released shows in the message list once a tag with that id exists.

allowManualRecipients.label: Manual recipients
allowManualRecipients.description: Without a recipient header, an address can be typed in (allowed domains only).

trashAfterRelease.label: Move to trash after release
trashAfterRelease.description: Moves the mail into the quarantine account's trash once the server has accepted every recipient.
